text:
Sam (PM): Quick sync on compact vs full scorecard approve flows. Main question: safe fast-path without confusing baseline semantics.
Lila (Design): Compact list: per-test quick actions should be less intrusive. Proposal: small check icon opens inline confirm, not immediate action. Full scorecard keeps big 'Approve & update' primary.
Nora (Product): Copy must disambiguate: 'Approve & update baseline' vs 'Mark as reviewed'. Users conflate them. Add tooltip and secondary explanatory copy beneath bulk CTA.
Dev (Eng): Backend supports both endpoints. We'll add telemetry for approve type. For inline confirm we'll expose data-qa attributes: data-qa=compact-approve and data-qa=compact-approve-confirm.
Priya (A11y): Inline confirm must get focus when shown and use aria-live polite: "Confirm baseline update for Test 7". Toasts should be role=status, dismissible, and not steal focus.
Lila (Design): For accidental approvals, require explicit confirm for bulk (modal) and inline two-click for single. Show small scope label: "Approving visible tests (12)".
Sam (PM): Keyboard shortcuts idea: 'a' approve focused row, 'Shift+A' bulk. Scope to list focus to avoid clashing with browser shortcuts. Show shortcut hint in tooltip.
Dev (Eng): We'll scope keyboard bindings to the component when it has focus. Also guard when inputs are focused.
Nora (Product): Bulk modal copy suggestion: "Approving will update baselines for X tests. This action writes new baselines and can be reverted within 10 minutes." Include link to run diffs.
ci-bot: baseline-update job queued for run 412 — ETA ~20s.
Priya (A11y): Contrast check reminder: buttons must meet 4.5:1. Also avoid ambiguous 'Yes' in confirm; use 'Approve & update' label.
Lila (Design): I'll update Figma with compact inline confirm states and full scorecard flows.
Sam (PM): Next steps: Lila updates mocks, Dev adds qa hooks and e2e stubs, Priya will validate SR flow, Nora will finalize copy. Target: PR by Friday.
Nora (Product): Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/approve-flows — comments enabled.
